answer: Probe first, bond second. Each fresh identity must lock 64 GB of uncompressed RAM and serve random-offset reads inside a 20-nanosecond budget over its memory bus — a zephyr of probes, fired blind, lands or misses on silicon timing alone. Verifier issues a random nonce per round, times the round trip, and demands matching access proof; a hollow claim of capacity stalls past budget and is discarded before the voyage of onboarding completes. Genuine hardware clears ~950 of 1000 probes; spoofed agents time out on the rest. Two failed rounds freeze emission and force re-stake.
